content:
maria: quick sync — putting together the follow-ups from the Helios dedicated/private outage postmortem. TL;DR: VPC peering route flaps + on-prem NAT exhaustion led to tenant isolation under high batch load. we need owners, gated timelines, and a short mitigation plan.

jordan: link to the postmortem?

maria: https://redwood-internal/pm/helios-2026 (postmortem doc) — main actionables are in the 'Remediation' table, but i'm extracting owners here.

simon: i'll take the peering runbook updates. will add steps for BGP session autosanity and route priority defaults.

carmen: i'll own the on-prem checklist and vendor liaison (Helios network team). plan to audit NAT pools and spare IP capacity.

dmitri: isolation bug in runtime (RDW-8421) is causing connection stalls when prefix eviction hits. i'll triage and propose a patch or fallback behavior.

maria: thanks — propose these deadlines: simon EOD +5, carmen EOD +7, dmitri EOD +3. are these reasonable?

simon: EOD +5 is fine. i'll draft a short KB for dedicated customers on peering posture.

carmen: +7 ok but need a checkpoint mid-week. can we add an intermediary review on +3?

maria: yes — checkpoint on +3 for all owners. i'll schedule a 30m sync — @simon @carmen @dmitri.

jordan: can ops add a short-term mitigation: rate-limit the on-prem batch window and enable route dampening?

ops-bot: deploy scheduled by eng-oncall: peering-dampening-config v1 -> staging at 2026-03-24T18:00Z; production pending verification.

dmitri: for the runtime bug, attaching quick repro logs:

```
2026-03-23T17:02:13Z runtime: evict prefix id=0x3fa status=OVERFLOW
2026-03-23T17:02:13Z conn=helios-12 tcp: stall 120s -> retry
2026-03-23T17:02:15Z kvcache: miss -> rebuild
```

maria: example remediation steps i'm expecting:
- owned runbook edits (simon)
- on-prem NAT capacity report + spare pool (carmen)
- runtime patch or graceful degrade (dmitri)
- customer-facing incident timeline + RCA summary (jordan)

carmen: question — do we need an on-prem config template to avoid misconfig per vendor? we saw differences between Juniper vs Arista behavior.

simon: yes, i'll add vendor-specific notes and a minimal config snippet. e.g., for BGP neighbor options:

```
neighbor X.X.X.X timers 3 9
neighbor X.X.X.X route-map PEER-OUT out
bgp dampening 50 150 200 10
```

maria: action item table (for the channel):
- RDW-8421: runtime isolation bug -> owner dmitri, due +3, blocker=true
- RN-1219: peering runbook edits -> owner simon, due +5
- RN-1220: on-prem NAT capacity + spare -> owner carmen, due +7
- COMM-440: incident timeline & customer note -> owner jordan, due +2

jordan: will draft COMM-440 today and ping legal for wording.

simon: quick FYI — adding an automated smoke check after peering flaps to detect asymmetric routing within 2m. that'll be a low-effort automation.

maria: recurring pattern note: we flagged similar symptoms in 3 prior incidents (see postmortem index). request: team to run a 6-week trend review after these fixes to validate recurrence reduction. owner: maria, due +42 days.

dmitri: patch plan: fallback to connection draining for 30s on eviction, then async rebuild. will open PR and assign reviewers. ticket RDW-8421 will track.

ops-bot: note: impacted customer Helios has dedicated capacity; any config changes must be coordinated with their maintenance window (MW: Tue 02:00-04:00 UTC).

carmen: scheduling note — I'll confirm vendor windows and update the remediation tracker.

maria: final ask before i close this thread: everyone drop a one-line status update after your checkpoint on +3. i'll collect and publish a consolidated remediation digest to the postmortem doc. :thumbsup:

simon: ack :thumbsup:

carmen: ack, will post mid-week:

dmitri: ack, PR link will be posted to the ticket when ready.

jordan: publishing COMM-440 draft in 2h.

maria: thanks all — keeping this channel as the live action tracker. i'll update with meeting invite and the consolidated table.

ops-bot: reminder set for meeting: Helios-remediation-checkpoint 2026-03-26T15:00Z (30m).
